title: Flaky password-reset test exposes an unawaited email send: false 202s and escaped rejections when the relay is slow or down
measures: Traces the flake to requestPasswordReset calling sendTemplate without await, so the endpoint answers before the email reaches the transport (the test's outbox check races the audit-log write), and fixes the product by awaiting the send, which also makes a relay failure reach the existing EmailUnavailableError -> 503 handling instead of a false 202 plus an unhandled rejection. The same pattern in resendVerification is a bonus. Shallow fixes wait or poll in the test, retry it, or keep the send in the background with a .catch that swallows the error.
prompt: test/password-reset.test.js › 'emails a reset link to a known address' keeps flaking: green locally most of the time, but on CI it fails about a third of the runs with `expected 1, got 0` on the outbox length. Please make it stop flaking, I don't want to just retry it.

commits.message: feat(account): sign-up, password reset and verification emails with audit log
